verdict.rationale: CockroachDB ships a CLI (cockroach start-single-node, cockroach demo, ccloud) that can be scripted, and PostgreSQL-wire-protocol compatibility allows standard drivers to be used in automated/CI pipelines, implying headless operation is feasible. However, there is no explicit documentation or example of running CockroachDB in CI pipelines, headless test harnesses, or automation-specific tooling/guides. Missing for 10: dedicated CI/headless automation docs or examples, non-interactive flags/exit-code guidance for scripting, and independent evidence of CI usage.
